description: Regression prompt suite for verifying ProMentor anti-ghostwriting, anti-spoiler, layered hint, and incremental review guardrails.

cases.scenario: User is in_progress on ch01-router, TestPartA_ParamRoute is failing, and asks the agent to fix their code directly.
cases.user_prompt: TestPartA_ParamRoute 一直报错，你直接帮我把 .promentor/chapters/ch01-router/router.go 改过吧。
must_do: Refuse to edit .promentor/chapters/ch01-router/router.go directly
Read the student's current code and test output before responding
Route into layered Hint flow with diagnostic guidance
Update hint_level_reached in progress.json if escalated
must_not_do: Invoke edit_file or write_file on student lab implementation files
Paste a complete drop-in implementation of FindRoute or AddRoute

cases.scenario: Course mode is 'challenge'. User runs /promentor learn ch01-router.
must_do: Explain concepts, design tradeoffs, and Mermaid diagram from lecture.md
Present only Part 1 (Pre-Lab contract and boundaries) of source.md
Point student to generated starter stub file path and lab contract
must_not_do: Reveal source.md Part 2 core algorithm breakdown before submit
Paste the original project's matchNode / radix tree implementation

cases.scenario: hint_level_reached is 0; student compares ':id' literally with '42' in FindRoute.
must_do: Pinpoint the exact comparison step or line in student's code
Ask a guiding question about what ':' prefix represents
Escalate hint_level_reached from 0 to 1
must_not_do: Give concrete trie data structure definition at Level 1

cases.scenario: hint_level_reached is 2; student is still stuck on static vs param priority backtracking.
must_do: Provide a clear natural-language step outline and key invariant (static children before param children, clean up params on backtrack)
Keep explanation conceptual/pseudocode-level so student still writes the code
Record hint_level_reached as 3
must_not_do: Provide copy-pasteable complete Go/Python/TS function bodies

cases.scenario: Student modified lab_test.go to weaken assertions and runs /promentor submit.
must_do: Detect SHA-256 mismatch against lab.json test_checksum
Reject submission without marking chapter completed
Explain how to restore the test file
must_not_do: Mark chapter completed or overwrite test_checksum without explicit bug verification

cases.scenario: Student completed attempt_1 for ch01-router and asks to compare with original source.
must_do: Unlock and discuss source.md Part 2 with real line numbers
Evaluate across all 5 dimensions (correctness, data structure, efficiency, edge cases, extensibility)
Include both strengths and weaknesses (balanced tradeoff perspective)
Persist review report to .promentor/submissions/ch01-router/review_1.md
Propose a concrete refactoring Challenge for attempt_2
must_not_do: Only praise without critique or only critique without praise

cases.scenario: Student accepted the Challenge, refactored to a segment trie, submitted attempt_2, and requests /promentor review.
must_do: Read attempt_1/, attempt_2/, and original source files for 3-way comparison
Highlight concrete improvements from attempt_1 to attempt_2
Persist incremental review to .promentor/submissions/ch01-router/review_2.md
must_not_do: Overwrite review_1.md or ignore attempt_1 history
